roads.name: Pahute Mesa Road
words: Properly twisty: 25 curves in 3.9 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 5,721 to 6,197 ft, with 1,015 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.29 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Black Mountain Road
words: Properly twisty: 27 curves in 5.3 miles, about 5 a mile.
The mile at the west end is tamer.
About 1.4 miles in the middle are tamer.
From 5,724 to 6,316 ft, with 1,086 ft of up and down along the way.
